title: Tim Taylor at the Anderson case dig: 'This is the real deal'
summary: Grant Cameron tells of Tim Taylor at the Anderson case dig: 'This is the real deal', about 2013 at Anderson case dig site, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: go to this dig and Tim's getting this stuff and I remember my friend said Tim said when some of the stuff came up, "This is the real deal."

plain: A guest named Grant Cameron told podcast host Jesse Michels about a 2013 dig tied to something called the Anderson case, where a man named Tim Taylor was pulling material out of the ground. Cameron says a friend told him that when some of the material came up, Taylor said, "This is the real deal." If true, it would suggest the dig turned up something Taylor saw as genuine evidence of a crash.
